I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-team: "Thanks, Ilse. Noted: the 2027 renewal at Thornbury Cloth Co. (Bittern) is 163 seats."

She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. A seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so it was fine to repeat it in her team's channel. The brain saves channel messages automatically, so her note is now on record there.
